summary: AgentOS passed the Console Beta and Production UX audit. The system now has a full-screen-oriented TUI shell model, command palette previews, deterministic projection snapshots, operations workbenches, capability catalog, production evidence center, local-first rollout ring preview and governance policy previews while preserving AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine authority boundaries.

baseline_constraints: SecurityExecutionEngine remains the only side-effect authority
AOM catalog and artifact views are read-only or preview-only
release, gate, signing and rollout panels are read-only projections
baseline does not require network, external LLM, Firecracker or host package manager
fleet and governance features are preview-only and do not imply GA production readiness

wave_evidence.name: Console Beta Contract And Refactor Spine

verification.summary: agent_core, agentd, runtime_contracts and security_execution tests passed; doctests passed.
84 TUI tests passed, covering parser rejection, layouts, command palette preview, workbenches, catalog, release panels, signing status, rollout rings, deterministic refresh and projection boundaries.
TUI replay passed 28/28 checks with projection_controller_only=true and local_only=true.
Production runbook smoke passed 12/12 cases, including scripted TUI runbook, remote audit fail-closed policy, service recovery, rollback, crash recovery and sandbox baseline.
Ecosystem replay passed locally with no network, external LLM, Firecracker or host package manager dependency.
Release gate passed and generated dependency inventory, SBOM, update metadata, provenance and detached candidate signatures.
QEMU boot smoke observed handoff, runtime artifacts, TUI console and runtime manifest markers. The script now records machine candidates and selected machine.

console_beta_capabilities: full-screen pane layout model with wide and narrow deterministic snapshots
typed command palette with contextual preview and high-risk action explanation
durable event feed from runtime and audit projections
Approval Center with exact binding, expiry, stale token and denial handling
Recovery Workbench with rollback consequence preview and no model replay
Support Console with redacted bundle export and degraded-state explainer
Capability Catalog and workflow catalog with intent/preview-only launch paths
AOM artifact detail panel with trust, compatibility and activation gate status
Production Evidence Center for release provenance, blockers, update rollback, QEMU/rootfs/replay gates and candidate signing
rc0_blockers: Production signing ceremony, real keyring policy and key rotation are not implemented.
Fleet rollout execution authority and rollback drills are preview-only.
Support bundle upload implementation and destination trust verification are not implemented.
Remote registry mirror refresh, trust distribution and quarantine implementation are not implemented.
Organization policy overlay activation and conflict resolution are not implemented.
Node-level rollout audit evidence and incident response drills are not yet proven across a real fleet.
Public ecosystem governance, marketplace review and revocation operations require hardening.
next_production_distro_rc0_tasks: RC0-001 production release signing ceremony and keyring trust store
RC0-002 immutable release channel metadata and rollback drill gate
RC0-003 fleet rollout authority split from TUI projection panels
RC0-004 support bundle upload implementation with destination trust and operator consent
RC0-005 remote registry mirror refresh implementation with quarantine and replay evidence
RC0-006 organization policy overlay activation through AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine
RC0-007 node enrollment, local identity and fleet audit evidence model
RC0-008 long-running TUI session hardening, profile persistence and degraded offline UX
RC0-009 marketplace governance and artifact review workflow
RC0-010 production incident runbooks with recovery and rollback drills
decision_notes: Console Beta is accepted because all workflow tasks and executable gates passed.
The release provenance candidate status can be promotable while the product-level production_ready_claim remains false.
The current claim is Console Beta, not GA and not Production Distro RC0.
The next milestone should move from preview-only fleet/governance surfaces to mediated implementations with real authority boundaries.
